title: Tai Parampara: Cultural Traditions, Festivals and Oral Literature of the Tai of Assam
title_as: টাই পৰম্পৰা আৰু সংস্কৃতি: লোক সাহিত্য, উৎসৱ আৰু সামাজিক নীতি (ড° ঐম্য খং গোহাঁই, ২০০৯)
author: Dr. Aimya Khang Gohain (Department of Assamese & Tai Studies, Dibrugarh University)
genre: Cultural Anthropology, Folk Customs & Oral Traditions
description: Comprehensive cultural and folkloric documentation of the Tai communities of Assam (Khamyang, Phake, Khamti, Aiton, Turung) by Dr. Aimya Khang Gohain. Analyzes seasonal festivals (Poi Sangken water festival, Poi Mai Ko Som fai, Poi Lu Lik), wedding songs, clan kinship rules, and oral historical chants.

units.translation_en: The Sangken festival is the joyous celebration welcoming the Tai New Year with holy water.
units.translation_as: ছাংকেন উৎসৱ হৈছে পৱিত্ৰ পানীৰে টাই নৱবৰ্ষক সাদৰে আদৰণি জনোৱাৰ পৰম্পৰাগত পৱিত্ৰ উৎসৱ।
